title: Feedback spaces and search typing
change: Spacebar is now handled as a named Bevy key in feedback and both search fields
steps: Press F8. Type two words with one space in every field. Try repeated spaces then Backspace and Enter. Close and reopen the editor
expected: Spaces and line breaks remain in the draft without jumping braking firing or opening Q
limits: Append and backspace editing only. Clipboard selection cursor editing and IME remain unfinished

title: Your in-game release checklist
change: F7 opens this sheet-authored guide from gameplay or menus. Personal checks save locally
steps: Mark this item checked then close with F7. Reopen and confirm the check. Try Report an issue then return with F8
expected: The checklist returns to the previous screen and retains personal checkmarks after restart
limits: Checkmarks are reminders only and never change the project acceptance sheets. Existing feedback drafts keep their original context until explicitly retargeted

title: Six prototype NPC registrations
change: Added Zombie and Zombie Torso plus Combine Soldier Elite Prison Guard and Odessa typed actors
steps: Open Q then NPCs. Choose one of the six enabled entries and aim at a clear floor. Try an unsupported NPC too
expected: Enabled entries request original animated actors. Unsupported entries remain visibly pending. Missing required animation data produces a visible error instead of a fake static NPC
limits: 79 NPC registrations remain disabled. Actual animation decoding and visual alignment need your checks

title: NPC pursuit damage and AI controls
change: Prototype direct pursuit with line-of-sight and opposing factions plus Disable AI and Ignore Players switches
steps: Spawn a zombie and a soldier on open floor. Observe pursuit and attack. Put a wall between targets. Toggle Disable AI and Ignore Players in the NPC browser
expected: AI switches change behavior. Walls block attack rays. Ignore Players still permits opposing NPC fights
limits: No native navigation schedules squads hearing or equipment models. Damage and timing are prototype tuning

title: NPC health saves and removal
change: NPC identity and health use version 4 scenes with guarded undo and unsupported-tool rejection
steps: Damage an NPC with an enabled weapon. Save then remove it with the remover tool. Undo and load the saved scene
expected: Health and NPC identity survive scene restoration. Unsupported tools explain why they cannot modify a live actor
limits: Dead NPCs disappear rather than becoming native ragdolls. Native save files and corpse settings are unsupported

title: Local player health and respawn
change: Hostile NPC damage now lowers HUD health and can trigger a delayed respawn
steps: Let a hostile NPC attack. Watch health reach zero. Wait three seconds with the game unpaused
expected: Movement and weapon use stop while dead. Respawn returns to the initial clear spawn point. A blocked point reports a recovery message
limits: No native armor fall damage crush damage teams or complete inventory reset. Pause freezes the respawn timer

title: Player collision and NoCollide
change: Player movement and vehicle exit queries now honor player collision masks
steps: Select NoCollide. Right-click a prop then walk through it. Toggle it back. Separately try a left-click pair constraint
expected: Right-click world-only props remain supported by the world but stop blocking the player. Left-click pair constraints affect only that prop pair
limits: Player pass-through is not the behavior of a pair-only constraint. Runtime collision acceptance is still needed

title: Click to equip weapons
change: 13 weapon routes include physgun toolgun and 11 primary-attack prototypes
steps: Open Q then Weapons and click an enabled item. Release the menu click then press fire while aiming safely at a prop or hostile NPC
expected: The item equips without an extra spawn step and subsequent clicks use its implemented primary action
limits: 21 weapons remain disabled. Native secondary attacks sounds and complete animation or ammo behavior remain incomplete

title: Vehicle axes and seating
change: 15 vehicle definitions use researched attachment frames with four powered prototypes and eleven passive seats
steps: Spawn Airboat Jeep Jalopy or APC on a clear suitable area. Enter with E. Try WASD and Space then exit with E. Inspect the facing direction
expected: Powered prototypes move along their intended forward axis and seats keep the camera aligned. Exit rejects blocked hull positions
limits: Passive seats do not drive. Native handling watercraft physics exact poses and entry cinematics remain unfinished

title: Stock model categories
change: Added 8390 memberships from 43 original spawn lists
steps: Open Q model browsing and choose different categories. Search within a category then clear the search
expected: The model list follows category membership and search rather than one uncategorized dump
limits: Only mounted supported models are usable. Full native spawn-browser layout and addon categories are incomplete

title: Water material revision
change: Original normal-map and transmission parameters now inform the water surface
steps: Visit water in gm_construct. Walk around the edge and compare above-water views at several angles
expected: Look for stable surface appearance and report flicker wrong normals color or incorrect water collisions
limits: Planar reflections underwater optics animated texture frames and native water simulation remain incomplete

title: Ground movement drift repair
change: Ground friction acceleration and collision-resolved velocity were revised against Source behavior
steps: On clear ground accelerate then release keys. Reverse direction. Try stairs slopes and a jump without holding other controls
expected: Check stopping and turning for unwanted sliding and report the exact map location and movement keys
limits: Native bunnyhop timing surfing crouching ladders water and moving-platform parity are not established

title: Still-open systems are not hidden
change: The sheets retain missing and partial native features instead of treating a successful build as a finished game
steps: Use pending menu entries to inspect limitations. Report the next highest-priority missing behavior with F8
expected: Missing functions should be labeled honestly and should not silently claim to work
limits: Networking Lua Workshop full menus options native vehicles 79 NPC types and many specialized entities remain open
